newsitem.title: UK: Unilever down ahead of Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Unilever down ahead of Q1 results.

text.p: Shares in Unilever Plc dipped in thin trade on Tuesday amid profit-taking ahead of Friday's first-quarter results, dealers and analysts said.
Some said an upbeat presentation to analysts in London by rival Procter & Gamble could have taken the shine of Unilever shares but analysts said nothing particularly new had come from the meeting.
Having touched a near record of 16.52-1/2 stg on Monday, Unilever shares were down 14-1/2p at 16.09 stg by 1201 GMT in trade of just 163,827 shares.

"The stock has had a good run, perhaps there is a bit of profit-taking ahead of the figures on Friday," said one market-maker. "And if P&G is doing well it might erode Unilever's performance a little."

Analysts said they expected Unilever's results on Friday to show a rise in pre-tax profit to between 530 million stg and 585 million, from 509 million a year before, but to be accompanied by cautious comment from the company's executives.
Paribas analyst John Campbell said the trading environment had, if anything, worsened in the first part of the year.

Unilever shares leapt higher at the start of February as the company announced the six billion stg sale of its speciality chemicals arm in a bid to expand its global presence in food and consumer products.
P&G last wwek posted a 16 percent rise in third quarter earnings.
